title: German-Style Chicken Schnitzel
description: A classic German dish made by breading and frying chicken breasts, often served with a side of lemon wedges and fries.
instructions: 1. Prepare the breading station: In one shallow dish, mix together flour, paprika, salt, and pepper. In another dish, beat the eggs. In a third dish, place the panko breadcrumbs.
2. Prepare the chicken: Season the chicken breasts with salt and pepper.
3. Dredge the chicken in the flour mixture, shaking off any excess.
4. Dip the floured chicken in the beaten eggs, making sure to coat completely.
5. Coat the egg-coated chicken in the panko breadcrumbs, pressing gently to adhere.
6. Heat about 1/2-inch (1 cm) of vegetable oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
7. Fry the breaded chicken breasts for about 3-4 minutes on each side, or until golden brown and cooked through.
8. Remove the fried chicken from the oil and place on a paper towel-lined plate to drain excess oil.
9. Serve the German-Style Chicken Schnitzel hot, garnished with lemon wedges if desired.
